about: Every chart in the library, built or to come. `ft` is the FT Visual Vocabulary folder it redesigns (reference/ft-2021/), null where the FT listed a chart and never built it, or `storyteller` where it comes from the Visual Storyteller. `methods` are the workshop pack's Ten Methods it can draw, which the Storyteller uses as its chart modes; `replaces` is the Storyteller drawing this chart took over; `storyteller` is the mode and sub-mode that draws with it now. Dropped from the FT set: the UK constituency map and cartogram, the US choropleth and the UK party columns, all tied to FT stories.

waves.1: What the Storyteller's methods draw, and their closest siblings
waves.2: The rest of the FT's built set
waves.3: Charts the FT listed and never built
waves.4: Maps: the world by country, Australia by state and council, close-ups with places marked

charts.name: Ordered column
charts.storyteller_line: Every row as a column, *biggest first*.

charts.name: Lollipop, horizontal
charts.storyteller_line: Every row on one scale, *biggest first*.

charts.name: Lollipop, vertical
charts.storyteller_line: Every row on one scale, *biggest first*.

charts.name: Slope
charts.note: The Storyteller parked cause-effect as a slope (too small and technical); this one is drawn big with at most seven lines.
charts.storyteller_note: the Storyteller's cause-effect mode is parked

charts.name: Bump
charts.storyteller_line: Each row's rank in every period, *the biggest mover marked*.

charts.name: Line
charts.reads: label, value (or one column per series)
charts.note: The Storyteller's trend is this line with its area filled.

charts.name: Area
charts.storyteller_line: Each part stacked over time, *the top edge the total*.

charts.name: Column over time
charts.storyteller_line: One number per period, *the latest marked*.

charts.name: Event timeline
charts.note: Events down a dotted spine, alternating sides.

charts.name: Donut
charts.note: FT's pie folder draws both; the Storyteller's proportions is the donut with a Depot stat in the hole.

charts.name: Proportional stacked bar
charts.storyteller_line: One whole as one bar, *split by share*.

charts.name: Treemap
charts.storyteller_line: One whole as tiles, *sized by share*.

charts.name: Bubble
charts.storyteller_line: {a} across, {b} up, *each dot sized by a third number*.

charts.name: Butterfly
charts.note: Names down the middle, A left in olive, B right in blue.

charts.name: Dumbbell
charts.note: FT calls it a dot plot.
charts.storyteller_line: Each row runs *from {a} to {b}*.

charts.name: Two windows
charts.note: A picture-led comparison; not in the FT set.
charts.storyteller_line: {a} and {b} side by side, *the numbers under each*.

charts.name: Grouped bar
charts.storyteller_line: {a} against {b}, *row by row*.

charts.name: Grouped column
charts.storyteller_line: {a} against {b}, *row by row*.

charts.name: Beeswarm
charts.note: Every row on one scale, the middle half shaded, the odd one out named.

charts.name: Histogram
charts.storyteller_line: Every row counted into bands, *the busiest marked*.

charts.name: Box plot
charts.storyteller_line: The middle half boxed, *the odd one out named*.

charts.name: Process spine
charts.note: A spine of numbered chevrons, each step's words beside it.

charts.name: Network
charts.note: FT listed it and never built it; the Storyteller did.

charts.name: Bar
charts.storyteller_note: ranking's bar covers it (the table's order is rarely the story)

charts.name: Diverging bar
charts.note: FT draws negatives with the plain bar.
charts.storyteller_line: Either side of zero, *gains right, losses left*.

charts.name: Diverging stacked bar
charts.note: Survey answers from disagree to agree.
charts.storyteller_line: Each row's answers either side of the middle, *the most positive right*.

charts.name: Diverging stacked column
charts.storyteller_note: comparison's likert draws it as bars, which read better on a slide

charts.name: Spine
charts.storyteller_line: {a} against {b}, *as shares of each row*.

charts.name: Population pyramid
charts.storyteller_line: {a} on the left, *{b} on the right*, back to back.

charts.name: Bullet
charts.storyteller_line: Each measure against its target, *the target a tick*.

charts.name: Proportional squares
charts.storyteller_line: Every row as a square, *its area the number*.

charts.name: Stacked bar
charts.storyteller_line: Each row one bar, *split into its parts*.

charts.name: Stacked column
charts.storyteller_line: Each period one column, *split into its parts*.

charts.name: Waterfall
charts.storyteller_line: How the total is built, *step by step*.

charts.name: Sankey
charts.storyteller_line: Where it goes, *each band as wide as the amount*.

charts.name: Two panels on one time axis
charts.note: Redraws FT's dual-axis line: two scales on one chart invite a false crossing, so each measure gets its own panel.
charts.storyteller_line: Two numbers on one time axis, *each on its own scale*.

charts.name: Intraday line
charts.storyteller_line: Through the hours of the day, *the latest marked*.

charts.name: Line with moving average
charts.storyteller_line: Each period, *the running average in olive*.

charts.name: Column and line
charts.note: Amount as columns, rate as a line, drawn as two panels unless both share a unit.
charts.storyteller_line: {a} in columns, *{b} as a line below*.

charts.name: Connected scatterplot
charts.reads: label, value, value2 in time order
charts.storyteller_line: {a} across, {b} up, *joined in order*.

charts.name: Heatmap, categories
charts.storyteller_line: Each row against each column, *darker is more*.

charts.name: Heatmap, quantities
charts.storyteller_line: {a} across, {b} up, *each cell shaded by a third number*.

charts.name: Calendar heatmap
charts.storyteller_line: One square a day, *darker is more*.

charts.name: Priestley timeline
charts.storyteller_line: Each one a span in time, *the longest marked*.

charts.name: Circles timeline
charts.storyteller_line: Events along time, *each circle sized by its number*.

charts.name: Small multiples: line
charts.note: Also covers FT's multiple-line panels.
charts.storyteller_line: One panel each, *all on one scale*.

charts.name: Small multiples: area
charts.storyteller_note: trend's multiples draws the same panels as lines

charts.name: Small multiples: column
charts.note: Also covers FT's column-timeline panels.
charts.storyteller_note: comparison's multiples draws the same panels as bars

charts.name: Small multiples: bar
charts.storyteller_line: One panel each, *all on one scale*.

charts.name: Surplus and deficit line
charts.storyteller_line: {a} against {b} over time, *the gap shaded*.

charts.name: Candlestick
charts.note: FT calls it stock price.
charts.storyteller_line: Each period's open and close, *its high and low*.

charts.name: Fan
charts.note: Uncertainty widening into a projection.
charts.storyteller_line: What has happened, *then the range of what could*.

charts.name: Seismogram
charts.storyteller_line: Every period a spike, *the biggest named*.

charts.name: Ordered proportional symbols
charts.storyteller_line: Every row as a circle, *its area the number*.

charts.name: Dot strip
charts.note: FT lists it under both ranking and distribution.
charts.storyteller_line: Every row a dot on one scale, *the odd one out named*.

charts.name: Violin
charts.storyteller_line: The shape of the spread, *the middle half as a bar*.

charts.name: Barcode
charts.storyteller_line: Every row a tick on one scale, *where they crowd shows*.

charts.name: Cumulative curve
charts.storyteller_line: Sorted smallest to biggest, *the halfway mark dotted*.

charts.name: Waffle
charts.note: FT calls it a gridplot.
charts.storyteller_line: One whole in a hundred squares, *one a per cent*.

charts.name: Sunburst
charts.storyteller_line: One whole split twice, *the inner ring by group*.

charts.name: Voronoi
charts.storyteller_note: hard to read at slide size

charts.name: Parliament arc
charts.note: A hemicycle of seats.
charts.storyteller_line: Every seat a dot, *coloured by its side*.

charts.name: Venn
charts.note: Echoes Oddview-29, the Express Venn diagrams.
charts.storyteller_line: What each set holds, *and what they share*.

charts.name: Proportional symbols
charts.storyteller_note: ranking's circles draws it biggest first

charts.name: Pictogram
charts.note: FT calls it isotype. Whole numbers only.
charts.storyteller_line: Counted in whole symbols, *one per unit*.

charts.name: Radar
charts.storyteller_line: Several measures round a circle, *one shape per row*.

charts.name: Parallel coordinates
charts.storyteller_line: Several measures side by side, *one line per row*.

charts.name: Chord
charts.storyteller_line: What passes between them, *both ways*.

charts.name: Choropleth
charts.note: Base maps: Natural Earth (world) and ABS boundaries (Australia, states, councils).
charts.storyteller_line: Each region shaded by its number, *darker is more*.

charts.name: Proportional symbol map
charts.storyteller_line: Each place a circle, *its area the number*.

charts.name: Flow map
charts.storyteller_line: From each place to the next, *thicker is more*.

charts.name: Contour map
charts.storyteller_line: Where it gathers, *smoothed into bands*.

charts.name: Equal-area cartogram
charts.note: FT's UK constituency cartogram is the example.
charts.storyteller_line: Every region the same size, *shaded by its number*.

charts.name: Scaled cartogram
charts.storyteller_line: Each region a circle, *its area the number*.

charts.name: Dot density map
charts.storyteller_line: One dot for every so many, *gathered where they are*.

charts.name: Grid heatmap map
charts.storyteller_line: Counted into squares, *darker is busier*.

charts.name: Locator map
charts.reads: label (a city) or lat, lon; note
charts.note: Not on the FT poster: where a place is, with a pin, a close-up and an overview inset. Otto, 18 Sep 2026.
